title: Nifty-500 momentum portfolio (monthly selection, daily breadth gate)
description: Preview / paper-experimental: monthly whole-share equal-weight momentum rebalance over current Nifty-500 constituents, plus a daily breadth gate that exits the strategy's own CNC holdings when breadth fails. The regime is replayed forward from a fixed anchor so the asymmetric 200/150-session index window is reproduced without lookahead. The budget below bounds this strategy's own arithmetic; the platform's admission ceiling is the authoritative limit and a rebalance it blocks is refused by name.

budget_inr.description: Sizing basis in INR for the equal-weight target. It must be the number the operator recorded as this strategy's admission allocation; the platform's admission ceiling is the binding limit, and a target above this basis is refused before any plan.

index_symbol.description: Catalog coordinate of the index ticker whose daily candles drive the trend leg. The catalog spells NSE indices with a space (NSE:NIFTY 500); resolve the instrument and use what the catalog returns.

constituents_source.description: Index constituent list used for the breadth gate and the momentum ranking. Membership is the current list applied to history, so the replay carries survivorship bias.

rebalance_kind.description: How the monthly rebalance session is chosen from the platform's verified NSE/CM calendar.

rebalance_day_of_month.description: First verified session on or after this calendar day. Used only by MONTHLY_CALENDAR_DAY.

initial_regime.description: Explicit state at regime_anchor_date for the day-by-day replay. DEFENSIVE is the conservative default; the choice is recorded in the run's log.

regime_anchor_date.description: Fixed ISO date the regime replay starts from. The window is derived from this anchor, never from 'today', so the same anchor gives the same window on every run. The replay also fetches 200 sessions of warm-up before the anchor.

regime_replay_max_sessions.description: Upper bound on replayed sessions. A longer anchor-to-today gap is refused by name rather than silently shortened.

fetch_concurrency.description: Parallel daily-history reads while building the constituent frame.

deadline_seconds.description: How long the child waits for a decision on an approval-based execution request.
